content.text: {"label":"marketing_campaign","explanation":"General is running about 50% over forecast for the day and +50-80% in recent intervals. Payments is near forecast (+1.9%). In general, loan_enquiry is at 3.48x normal (+111 calls in the last hour) and account_update is at 1.8x. This matches the 10:15 SMS to 700,000 people: 'Home-loan balance transfer at 8.4%, call us today to switch.' There is no open incident, so it is not an outage. AHT is below forecast, so it is not system slowness. General absences (2) are below the usual 2.5, so it is not a supply problem. Payments has 5 sick against 2.6 usual, but it is coping at near-forecast volume.","plan_name":"General queue: rebuild capacity for home-loan campaign demand to 20:00","rationale":"Morning measures have mostly expired: IVR callback ended at 14:00, chat deflection and coaching cancellation at 15:00, and overtime at 15:45. Demand is still running about 50-80% above forecast, so I am re-applying the levers for the rest of the day. Coaching is cancelled and breaks delayed on general (agents already delayed this morning are skipped automatically). Two consecutive overtime offers cover 16:15-20:00: roughly 4 acceptances each, about Rs 5,400 in total. Assuming morning acceptance was similar (about 8 agents for 2 hours, roughly Rs 5,760), that keeps the day under the Rs 15,000 budget. The IVR callback smooths peaks. Chat deflection takes the eligible reasons (balance_enquiry, new_offer_enquiry), as loan_enquiry cannot be deflected. I am not moving cross-skilled agents from payments: its service level has swung between 54% and 100% and it is short-staffed through sickness, so it cannot safely stay at or above 70%.
